Ignore any person, mannequin or background in the product photos. The first photos show the woman herself: she must be the same person, with the same face, hair and skin tone, but wearing only the outfit described.
scale_note: Not used in prompts: people are generated separately and placed side by side by render.py.
relight: RELIGHT: discard the character sheet's flat studio lighting completely and light her from scratch to the room: late-afternoon sun through the ocean glass as the key light from camera left, a warm fill bouncing up off the cream marble floor, a faint green bounce from the olive tree on her shadow side, a real soft contact shadow from her feet across the jute rug. She is physically standing in the room, never a cut-out pasted on a background, never brighter than the room.
realism: Photorealistic lifestyle-lookbook photograph taken on a modern phone, casual slightly imperfect framing, true-to-life colors, matte unretouched skin with visible pores and fine peach fuzz, no airbrushing, no skin smoothing, no plastic skin, no CGI look.
pose: Lookbook pose, not a passport photo: weight on one leg, one hand resting lightly in a pocket or at a cuff, shoulders relaxed, a calm alive gaze toward the camera.
modest: Modest fully-clothed styling, opaque fabric, torso fully covered.
no_ip: No logos, no brand marks, no readable text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image. No celebrity or real-person likeness.
frame: Vertical 3:4, full length from the top of her head to her shoes with space above her head; the upper third of the frame is calm wall, glass and sky (captions go there).
